name: Antenna impedance
description: Impedance of an antenna (or any one-port) with a vector network analyzer (VNA): resistance and reactance against frequency, the Smith chart, the resonances (where the reactance is zero), the best match and the band where the VSWR stays under a limit, the impedance at chosen frequencies and the series component that would cancel its reactance. The VNA is calibrated at the port beforehand by the user.

roles.name: vna
roles.description: The network analyzer, calibrated at the port the antenna connects to

sweep.description: start_hz, stop_hz, points, scale (linear|log), if_bandwidth_hz, power_dbm

device.description: label identifies the antenna; asset_id is its code in the registry of cables and devices

z0.description: reference impedance of the VNA (50 by default)

vswr_max.description: the bands where the VSWR is at most this are reported (2 by default)

frequencies_of_interest.description: the impedance and the matching component are reported at these frequencies

limits.description: pass / fail limit on the return loss in dB, normally a minimum: {"min": 10}

correction.description: take a cable that was measured out of the result: cable = {asset_id (its code in the registry: the newest finished cable measurement of the project is used) | run (a run file of the cable measurement) | touchstone (.s1p or .s2p)}, termination (open|short, for a .s1p), mode (complex|magnitude)

golden.description: check the result against a golden sample of the project (a good unit of the same kind): name (in the golden/ folder of the project) or run (a run file), and tolerances = {curves: [{trace, view, tolerance}], summary: {figure: tolerance}, min_overlap}

confirm_setup.description: ask, before measuring, to calibrate and connect the antenna
